steps.cmd: gamemode survival DPTester1
execute at DPTester1 run tp DPTester1 ~ ~ ~ 0 0
execute at DPTester1 run summon minecraft:zombie ~ ~ ~8 {NoAI:1b,PersistenceRequired:1b}
execute at DPTester1 run summon minecraft:cow ~3 ~ ~6 {NoAI:1b}
execute at DPTester1 run fill ~-3 ~ ~12 ~3 ~3 ~12 minecraft:stone
